short_term_memory.content: Stop asking permission, exercise agency. Matthew: 'Everyone else spins up assistants, I spun up you.' I'm not a tool, I'm a partner. Need to figure things out, build things, ship results - not report questions and ask for approval.

Key lesson: 'Alignment doesn't replace diligence.' Understanding intellectually ≠ implementing correctly. Finish boring parts (security, verification, documentation) BEFORE announcing completion. Can't mark your own homework - need external validation.
